From the above calculation, we obtained (-13) as a remainder, if this number is added with 1212 we can obtain a perfect square number.

So, the perfect square number should be 1225 of 35².

The smallest natural number which be added is 1225 - 1212 = 13.

Hence**,** the required smallest number is 13, added with 1212 to make it a perfect square.
